agenda_fuso_dica: IANA name, like America/Sao_Paulo. Empty uses the zone of the box.
agenda_intro: A scene at a time of day, on the days of the week you pick. It runs on the hub itself, with no internet. If the hub is off at that minute, the scene does not run late.
agenda_sem_cena: Create a scene above to schedule it.
assistente_enviar: Set the password and sign in
assistente_intro: This hub has no owner yet. Whoever sets the password first becomes the owner, so set it now: until a password exists, anyone who reaches this panel on the local network can claim the hub.
assistente_restaurar_texto: A new box in place of another: pick the backup file and type its password. The owner and the password of the old installation apply here.
cadastro_identidade_dica: The device UUID, MAC or serial number. The IP is never the key: the discovery finds it again.
cadastro_na_nuvem: This device has no local API: the hub talks to the cloud of the maker, so there is no address to fill in. Fill the fields below and pair.
cadastro_nivel_maximo_dica: The highest level this equipment accepts, from anywhere: panel, app, scene. A request above it becomes this value. 100 is no limit.
catalogo_indisponivel: The panel has not managed to read the driver catalog from the hub yet. The read repeats every cycle.
cenas_intervalo_ajuda: An AV device needs a moment before it takes the next command. A step may carry its own wait.
cenas_intro: A scene is a list of steps. Each step sends one command to one device, and between one step and the next the hub waits out the interval of the scene. There are thirty two scenes, numbered by position, and the same number fires the same scene on every licence.
cenas_menos: Show only the scenes in use
cenas_sem_equipamento: Register an equipment to create steps.
cenas_sem_opcao: No options: register the list on the equipment.
cenas_vazia: No steps. Add the first one.
clima_sem_setpoint: In this mode the unit picks the temperature itself. Change the mode to adjust it.
conta_atualizacao_como: The hub does not replace its own image: updating is a command on the host it runs on.
conta_atualizacao_sem_internet: The published versions could not be checked. The hub may have no internet access.
conta_atualizacao_sem_release: No version has been published yet; this is the installed one.
conta_backup_senha_dica: At least 12 characters. Without it the file opens nowhere, not even here.
conta_backup_texto: The whole installation in one file: equipment with credentials, licences with keys, numbers, scenes, schedules and the owner password. The file is encrypted with a password of its own; keep both.
conta_buscar: Find the devices of the account
conta_cofre_arquivo: This machine has no readable serial number, so the key of the secrets is a file beside the data. It protects from another user of the machine, not from whoever takes the card.
conta_cofre_ilegiveis: There are secrets written by another board that this hub cannot read. Enter the credentials and licence keys again, or restore a backup.
conta_cofre_placa: The key of the secrets is derived from the serial number of this board: the card alone, in another machine, opens nothing.
conta_intro: The panel password, the session of this window and the state of the daemon.
conta_manutencao_texto: Check for a newer version and restart the hub when needed. The speakers keep playing during the restart.
conta_nome_dica: Shown at the top of the panel and in the app. Up to 60 characters.
conta_reiniciando: Restarting. The panel comes back on its own.
conta_reiniciar_pergunta: Restart now? The speakers keep playing; the panel is back in about 10 seconds.
conta_restaurando: Restoring and restarting. The page reloads on its own.
conta_restaurar_pergunta: Replace the whole installation with the one in the file and restart the hub?
conta_restaurar_texto: Replaces the whole installation with the one in the file and restarts the hub. Every session ends, this one included.
conta_seguranca_texto: The names this hub answers by on the network and where the key of the secrets lives.
conta_sessao_texto: Signing out closes only the session of this window. The others stay valid until the password is changed.
conta_vazia: The account has no device of this kind.
controles_extra_ajuda: A raw command for the driver, as its documentation describes.
controles_grupo_alheio: This speaker is held in a group this hub does not lead, built with the manufacturer's app or left by a restart: volume, playback, radios and input stay locked until the group is dismantled. The hub asks it to leave once a minute.
controles_grupo_escravo: This speaker is in a group and follows the master: volume, playback and radios go to it, and the input stays locked until the group is dismantled.
controles_grupo_mestre: This speaker leads a group: what it plays goes to the others.
controles_sem_atalhos: No radio registered. Add one on the lists card of the panel, further down, where the driver shows its format and its examples.
controles_sem_lista: Register the list on the lists card of the panel, further down.
daemon_indisponivel: The daemon did not answer the panel.
descoberta_faixa_dica: Optional. Without it the sweep uses multicast, which does not cross every network: on a hub inside a container it finds nothing. With the range of the network of the installation, the hub asks every address in it who answers. Private ranges only, up to 1024 addresses.
descoberta_intro: The sweep lists the devices of the local network and offers to register the ones a driver exists for.
descoberta_sem_identidade: The device did not announce an identity. Register it by hand with its UUID, MAC or serial number.
detalhe_auth_pendente: The device has not been paired yet.
detalhe_contrato_quebrado: The driver answered outside the driver contract. Read the container log.
detalhe_eq_offline: The device did not answer the last poll.
detalhe_erro_aparelho: The device answered with an error.
detalhe_invalid_value: The device refused the value that was sent.
detalhe_nao_encontrado: No equipment with that identity. It may have been removed in another session.
detalhe_nao_suportado: The driver does not declare that action.
detalhe_sem_controle: This driver declares no command, only state reading.
detalhe_tipo_desconhecido: No driver in this image has the type of this registration.
editor_intro: Start from a template, adjust the JSON and validate. The daemon is the one that accepts or refuses the file, field by field.
editor_precedencia: A driver from the integrator wins over a driver of the image with the same type.
editor_salvo: Driver saved. The hub has loaded it already, with no restart.
editor_substitui_imagem: A driver of the image already has this type. The file saved here takes its place.
editor_substitui_integrador: A driver from the integrator already has this type. Saving replaces that file.
editor_tab_ajuda: Tab indents. Esc and then Tab leaves the editor.
editor_validado: The daemon accepted this file. You can save it now.
erro_acesso_exigido: Getting in from outside asks for the code of the window.
erro_acesso_invalido: Wrong window code, or the code of a window that already closed.
erro_acesso_negado: This door does not answer here.
erro_agendamento_ativo_invalido: The active field must be yes or no.
erro_agendamento_cena_invalida: Invalid scene: pick one from 1 to 32.
erro_agendamento_dias_invalidos: Pick at least one day of the week.
erro_agendamentos_invalidos: Some schedules have problems; see the list.
erro_agendamentos_nao_lista: The schedules must be a list.
erro_auth_pendente: The device needs to be paired first.
erro_backup_invalido: This file is not a backup of this product, or it is damaged.
erro_campo_invalido: An obligatory field is empty or outside the type the driver asks for.
erro_cena_chave_desconhecida: A key the scene format does not know. A key nobody reads is a scene doing less in silence.
erro_cena_em_curso: This scene is already running. Wait for it to finish.
erro_cena_equipamento_desconhecido: This step names an equipment that is not registered.
erro_cena_equipamento_invalido: The step must name the identity of an equipment.
erro_cena_espera_invalida: The wait is outside the band a scene takes.
erro_cena_intervalo_invalido: The interval between steps must be an integer in milliseconds, within the ceiling of the daemon.
erro_cena_nao_encontrada: No scene with steps under that number.
erro_cena_nao_objeto: Each scene must be an object with a name and steps.
erro_cena_nome_invalido: The name of a scene is short and carries no control character.
erro_cena_passo_nao_objeto: Each step must be an object with equipment, action, value and wait.
erro_cena_passos_demais: Too many steps in this scene.
erro_cena_passos_invalidos: The steps must be a list.
erro_cena_valor_invalido: Value outside what the action of this step takes.
erro_cenas_demais: At most thirty two scenes, one per value of the scene data point.
erro_cenas_invalidas: The daemon refused the list of scenes. See the fields listed.
erro_cenas_nao_lista: The scenes must be a list.
erro_codigo_invalido: The authenticator code is wrong or was already used.
erro_confirmacao: The two passwords are not the same.
erro_copia_falhou: The browser did not allow copying. Select the text and copy it by hand.
erro_corpo_invalido: Request or answer outside the API contract.
erro_decl_arquivo_grande: The file is too large for a driver.
erro_decl_base_invalida: The HTTP base may only point at the equipment itself.
erro_decl_cabecalho_invalido: Header outside the format. Its value comes from a registration field, never from the file.
erro_decl_campo_desconhecido: A state field the contract does not have.
erro_decl_chave_desconhecida: A key the format does not know. A key nobody reads is a driver that silently does less.
erro_decl_comando_invalido: The command is outside the format.
erro_decl_config_campo_invalido: A registration field is outside the format: nome, tipo, obrigatorio and padrao.
erro_decl_descoberta_invalida: The discovery signatures are outside the format.
erro_decl_em_uso: Equipment is registered with this type.
erro_decl_escala_invalida: The volume scale has to run from a minimum to a larger maximum.
erro_decl_estado_invalido: The state block is outside the format.
erro_decl_hex_invalido: The hex literal has to be made of pairs, from 00 to FF.
erro_decl_intervalo_invalido: The interval between commands is outside what the engine accepts.
erro_decl_invalido: The daemon refused the file. Read the fields it listed.
erro_decl_json_invalido: The text is not a valid JSON object.
erro_decl_leitura_invalida: The state reading is outside the format.
erro_decl_manifesto_invalido: The manifest is outside the contract format.
erro_decl_metodo_invalido: The HTTP method has to be GET, POST or PUT.
erro_decl_nao_encontrado: No driver from the integrator has that type.
erro_decl_nao_objeto: The file has to be a JSON object.
erro_decl_porta_invalida: The port has to be between 1 and 65535.
erro_decl_regex_invalida: The regular expression does not compile.
erro_decl_regex_perigosa: This regular expression hangs on the fire test of the daemon.
erro_decl_regex_sem_grupo: A reading regular expression needs a capture group.
erro_decl_repete_invalido: The repetition is outside what the engine accepts.
erro_decl_rotulo_invalido: The label needs text in pt and en.
erro_decl_terminador_invalido: The terminator is outside what the transport accepts.
erro_decl_texto_nao_gravavel: This text has a character the file cannot store. Delete it and type it again.
erro_decl_textos_invalidos: The panel texts have to exist in both languages, pt and en.
erro_decl_timeout_invalido: The deadline is outside what the engine accepts.
erro_decl_tipo_invalido: The type has to be a plain identifier: lower case letters, digits and underscore.
erro_decl_tipo_ocupado: A native driver of this image already has that type. Pick another one.
erro_decl_transporte_invalido: The transport has to be exactly one: tcp, http or udp.
erro_decl_valores_invalido: The values of a command have to map a panel value to a wire value.
erro_decl_vocabulario_invalido: Word list (keys, modes or fan speeds) outside the vocabulary, or without the capability that speaks it.
erro_dp_desconhecido: This data point is not in the DP-bus contract.
erro_dp_somente_leitura: This data point is only reported by the hub, and nobody writes to it.
erro_erro_aparelho: The device answered with an error.
erro_erro_interno: Internal daemon error. Read the container log.
erro_faixa_grande: Range too large. The ceiling is 1024 addresses, which is a /22.
erro_faixa_publica: That range is not a local network. The hub only sweeps a private range.
erro_fuso_invalido: Unknown time zone. Use an IANA name, like America/Sao_Paulo.
erro_host_nao_permitido: Host name refused. Open the panel by IP address, or add the name to hosts_permitidos in config.json and restart the container.
erro_identidade_duplicada: There is already equipment with that identity.
erro_identidade_invalida: The order of the devices must be a list of identities.
erro_invalid_value: Value outside what that action accepts.
erro_ip_invalido: The address has to be an IP literal, no name, no port and no URL.
erro_ja_configurado: This hub already has a password. Use the sign in screen.
erro_licenca_desconhecida: Licence the hub does not know.
erro_licenca_incompleta: Fill in the UUID and the PID of the licence to build the QR code.
erro_licenca_invalida: Licence field outside the format: short name, uuid, pid and key in printable ASCII.
erro_licenca_repetida: A licence with this identifier already exists.
erro_licencas_demais: The hub takes up to 16 licences.
erro_lista_demais: Too many items in this list: up to 10 inputs, 8 shortcuts and 8 modes.
erro_lista_invalida: Each list item needs a label of up to 16 characters, without comma, vertical bar or semicolon, and a value.
erro_metodo_nao_permitido: Method not allowed on this route.
erro_muitas_tentativas: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
erro_nao_configurado: This hub has no password yet. Use the first access screen.
erro_nao_encontrado: Route not found on the hub.
erro_nao_suportado: This driver does not declare that action.
erro_nome_invalido: The name takes up to 60 characters, with no control character.
erro_nome_nao_gravavel: This name has a character the hub cannot publish. Erase it and type it again.
erro_nomes_demais: Too many names for this data point.
erro_nomes_longos: The names together do not fit the 255 bytes of the data point. Shorten one of them.
erro_numero_ocupado: This equipment already has a number in another licence. Take it out of there first.
erro_numero_offline: The equipment of this number did not answer, or the number is empty.
erro_numero_repetido: The same equipment cannot occupy two numbers.
erro_numeros_demais: The licence does not have that many numbers.
erro_origem_nao_permitida: The hub refused the origin of the request.
erro_otp_exigido: This hub asks for the authenticator code.
erro_painel_ausente: The panel is not built into this image.
erro_perfil_longo: The profile of this equipment is over 200 bytes. Shorten the labels or drop items from the lists.
erro_perfis_longos: The profiles of the equipment of this licence do not fit the data points. Shorten labels or lists.
erro_produto_incompativel: An air conditioner only enters an air conditioner licence, and everything else only enters an audio and video one.
erro_produto_invalido: The product of a licence is air conditioner or audio and video, and it does not change once created.
erro_qr_falhou: The QR code could not be drawn.
erro_sem_home: The app has not yet written to this hub the home it belongs to.
erro_sem_otp: No authenticator app is paired yet.
erro_sem_pareamento: Start the pairing again: the secret that was shown is no longer valid.
erro_sem_relay: The address of the relay of the remote access is missing.
erro_sem_resposta: The daemon did not answer. Check that the container is up.
erro_senha_curta: The password needs at least 8 characters.
erro_senha_fraca: The panel password predates the current minimum. Change it before opening the remote access.
erro_sessao_invalida: Session expired or revoked. Sign in again.
erro_tipo_desconhecido: No driver in this image has that type.
erro_valor_invalido: Value outside what this data point takes.
inicio_intro: Everything the hub controls on your network. Tap an equipment to see its state and command it.
inicio_vazio_texto: The hub works anyway. Add the first one by discovering it on the network or by hand.
licenca: Free software under the AGPL-3.0-only license. A commercial license is offered in parallel by Quero Automação Ltda.
licencas_chave_dica: The key stays on the hub and never comes back to the panel. When editing, leave it blank to keep the current one.
licencas_id_dica: Optional. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore.
licencas_intro: Each licence is a device on Tuya: a pairing QR code on the app and a slice of the data points. An air conditioner one carries up to 8 machines; an audio and video one carries up to 12 equipment.
licencas_qr_ajuda: Scan it on the QA app to pair this device. The QR carries the PID and the UUID; the key stays on the hub.
licencas_remover_pergunta: Remove this licence? The equipment stays registered; only their numbers leave the app.
licencas_vazio: No licence registered. Create the first one to pair the hub on the app.
listas_ajuda_modos: The sound modes of the equipment.
listas_exemplos: Use the examples of the driver
listas_exemplos_fontes: Use the inputs the speaker declares
listas_intro: Each item becomes a button on the app. The label shows on the screen; the value goes to the driver.
listas_sem_fontes: The speaker has not said which inputs it has yet.
log_intro: Everything the daemon did, in order: what each driver put on the wire, what the Tuya bridge asked for and what the panel changed. Use it to diagnose a driver or an integration.
log_vazio: Nothing here yet. Lines show up as the hub works.
login_acesso_dica: The eight characters shown in the app of the customer and in the panel of whoever opened the window.
login_codigo_dica: The six digits of Google Authenticator, 1Password or whichever app you paired with this hub.
login_senha: Type the access password you set:
marca: Tuya is a trademark of Tuya Inc., used nominatively.
marcas_fabricantes: Maker names and logos are registered trademarks of their respective owners, cited here to say what the hub controls.
multiroom_alheio: This device is in a group the hub does not lead.
multiroom_escolha: Who joins the group this device leads:
multiroom_intro: This device groups with others of the same type: one leads and the chosen ones play the same audio. Tick who joins the group; whoever stays out keeps playing whatever it likes. A scene builds the group too, one member per step.
multiroom_precisa_numero: Give this device a number on the app to be able to group.
multiroom_segue: This device follows the group of
multiroom_sem_par: No other device of the same type has a number on the app.
multiroom_solo: This device plays on its own.
nav_precisa_equipamento: Register a device and this menu opens.
novo_intro: Search the local network or register by hand by driver type.
numero_intro: The app of the customer shows the equipment of each licence, numbered. Without a number this equipment does not appear on the app, but the scenes of the hub still reach it.
numero_sem_licenca: No licence of this product. Create one on the Account.
par_aguardando: Waiting for the confirmation on the device.
par_aguardando_codigo: The device showed the code on its screen. Type it in the code field of this equipment, save, and pair again.
remoto_codigo_dica: The integrator sees this same code in the app of the customer and types it when getting in from outside. It changes with every window and dies with it.
remoto_conectando: The window is open and the hub is still reaching the relay.
remoto_intro: Opens a window of 24 hours for the integrator to get in from outside, and closes on its own. Three locks: an address that exists only during the window, the code of the window, and the password with the authenticator code.
remoto_otp_ativo: An authenticator app is already paired with this hub.
remoto_otp_ausente: No authenticator app paired. Without one, the remote access does not open.
remoto_otp_leia: Read the code with Google Authenticator, 1Password or another app and type the six digits it shows.
remoto_otp_remover_aviso: This closes an open window, ends every session, and leaves the remote access unavailable until another app is paired.
remoto_otp_segredo: Or type this secret into the app
remoto_recusado: The relay refused this hub: its home is not registered with Quero Automação. Only installations registered by a QA Master company get remote access.
remover_pergunta: Remove this equipment from the hub?
segredo_guardado: A credential is stored in the hub. Leave it blank to keep it.
simulador_intro: How the customer's app sees this installation: the same devices, scenes and group the hub publishes on the DP-bus. What you tap here really reaches the devices.
simulador_sem_licenca: No licence. Create one on the Account and give numbers to the equipment.
simulador_vazio: No device has a number on the app. Open a device and give it one.
subtitulo: Bridge between the Tuya platform and IP equipment on your local network
trocar_aviso: Changing the password closes every other panel session and rotates the machine credential the DP-bus uses.
trocar_ok: Password changed. Every other session was closed and the machine credential was rotated.
